newsitem.title: INDIA: India call money at 0.25-0.50 pct on reporting day.
newsitem.headline: India call money at 0.25-0.50 pct on reporting day.

text.p: Indian call money was quoted in the 0.25-0.50 percent range on Friday, dealers said.
The quotes were largely indicative and no deals were reported as it was the reporting day, they said.

Banks in India report their positions to the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) every fortnight on alternate Fridays. They do not normally borrow on the reporting day as this increses reserve requirements for the next fortnight.
Call money rates have been firm in the last two weeks due to heavy cash withdrawals for the festive seasons, open market operations by the RBI and an increase in corporate bank borrowings.
Rates touched 12.50 percent on November 14 before easing to the 10.25-10.75 percent range subsequently. Call money ended Thursday around seven percent with stray deals at three percent.
Dealers said they expected call money to open around nine percent on Saturday.
